For low desire or arousal: one approved option for women, and what the online "PT-141" really is.

One peptide is FDA approved, for low sexual desire in premenopausal women, and needs a prescription. The same molecule sold as PT-141 by online shops is not an approved product.

  • Bremelanotide (Vyleesi)FDA approvedA shot taken before sex, approved for low sexual desire in premenopausal women.

    A shot you take before sex, approved for low sexual desire in premenopausal women.

    FDA approved.

    Prescription.

  • PT-141 from online shopsNot an approved productThe same molecule as Vyleesi, sold without a prescription in research-use vials.

    The same molecule as Vyleesi, sold without a prescription by research-use shops: no dose control, no checks.

    Not an approved product.

    Research-use shops.

  • Melanotan IINot approved for any useA tanning peptide also sold for libido, linked to serious side effects.

    A tanning peptide also sold "for libido". Linked to serious side effects; never approved anywhere.

    Not approved for any use.
